transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been feeling incredibly high and full of energy for the past three months, but I'm also getting irritable and angry at the smallest things. I just can't seem to stay still or stop moving, and it’s become really overwhelming.

During these past three months, have you experienced any periods where your behavior or energy level became so extreme that you required hospitalization or were unable to function in your daily life or job?

Yes, it’s been extreme; I’ve drained my savings on reckless business ventures and impulsive shopping sprees that have left me in serious financial trouble. I’ve completely lost my ability to keep up with my job because I just can't focus on anything anymore.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports a three-month duration of symptoms including reckless spending and a complete loss of ability to function at their job, which meets the criteria for a manic episode. Because the impairment is severe enough to cause significant functional impairment (loss of employment and financial ruin), Bipolar I Disorder is the accurate diagnosis, making Bipolar II Disorder unlikely.
